'''Watto's hangar''', owned by the [[Color/Legends|blue]]<ref name="JGG">''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]]<ref name="tpm">{{Film|I}}</ref> named [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].<ref name="JGG" /> At some point before the events of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] took place in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], and [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]] died during the film. As Tyerell was shown to be alive in ''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]'', it must have taken place before the events of ''The Phantom Menace''.</ref> an [[Unidentified extra-galactic spacer|extra–galactic spacer]] was allowed to use the hangar to make repairs on their highly damaged [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="JGG" />
